message.wendigosfrost.marked: The cold clings to your bones...
message.wendigosfrost.awakened: A distant scream cuts through the silence.
message.wendigosfrost.ritual_start: The ritual has begun. Stay close and avoid damage!
message.wendigosfrost.ritual_complete: The ice within your blood melts away. You are free!
message.wendigosfrost.roar_warning: The Wendigo inhales! Escape the roar!
message.wendigosfrost.stomp_warning: The ice trembles! Dodge the shockwave!
message.wendigosfrost.summon_structure: Incomplete ritual: place 4 lit soul campfires two blocks away in the cardinal directions, plus 4 blue ice blocks diagonally adjacent.
message.wendigosfrost.summon_cooldown: The altar is still frozen. Wait %s seconds.
message.wendigosfrost.summon_existing: There is already another Wendigo nearby. Defeat it before repeating the ritual.
message.wendigosfrost.summon_failed: The frozen portal failed. Please try again.
message.wendigosfrost.summon_space: No safe spawn area nearby. Clear a large open area around the altar.
message.wendigosfrost.summon_success: The ice shatters... THE WENDIGO HAS BEEN SUMMONED!
message.wendigosfrost.summon_busy: The altar is already performing a cleansing ritual.
message.wendigosfrost.ward_wave: The Frost Ward released a Frost Shockwave! Enemies hit: %s
tooltip.wendigosfrost.frost_ward: Right click: Frost Shockwave. 6 charges; 30-second cooldown.
tooltip.wendigosfrost.lost_page: Right-click to read the hunter's final account.
tooltip.wendigosfrost.winter_sigil: Night vision (30 s), protection (8 s), cooldown 90 s.
message.wendigosfrost.rune_0: The stone whispers: The bloom opens the gate. The crystal wakes the hunger.
message.wendigosfrost.rune_1: The stone whispers: Four soul flames, four blue ice blocks... and winter answers.
message.wendigosfrost.rune_2: The stone whispers: One heart, one horn, one crystal. The frost can be broken.
message.wendigosfrost.page_1: Thirteenth winter journal — The settlement found blue flowers beneath the roots.
message.wendigosfrost.page_2: Our watch failed. It crawls on all fours, but when wounded it rises like a man.
message.wendigosfrost.page_3: If you hear winter's heartbeat, seek the ancient sanctuaries. The stones remember.
message.wendigosfrost.sigil: The sigil lights your eyes. You see through the cold.
screen.wendigosfrost.title: WENDIGO'S FROST
screen.wendigosfrost.story_1: Before the villagers came, hunters raised shrines to contain a hunger without a name. Beneath the frost, strange blue flowers kept growing.
screen.wendigosfrost.story_1b: To consume a Frostbloom Crystal is to accept the Winter Mark. Three days later, something may begin following your tracks.
screen.wendigosfrost.subtitle_2: THE CURSE AND THE LAST RITUAL
screen.wendigosfrost.story_2: The Wendigo stalks on all fours, but rises when wounded. Its roar heralds the cold. Run, fight, or search for the hunters' ruins.
screen.wendigosfrost.story_2b: Explore sanctuaries, read the runestones and discover how to break the curse. Your survival guide is in your inventory.
tooltip.wendigosfrost.rune_spear: Extra damage against the Wendigo's exposed heart.
tooltip.wendigosfrost.thaw_axe: Burns the Wendigo and interrupts its ice abilities.
tooltip.wendigosfrost.hunter_armor: Each piece reduces 8% of Wendigo damage (up to 32%).
tooltip.wendigosfrost.thermal_flare: Releases a thermal burst that burns nearby Wendigos.
tooltip.wendigosfrost.heartbreaker_blade: Deals extra damage to the enraged Wendigo in phase 3.
tooltip.wendigosfrost.runic_torch: Runic light that weakens and slows Wendigos for 5 seconds.
